name: scholarship-service
description: Standalone scholarship-automation service (headless Playwright), same shape as ../agent-runner-service rather than bolted onto the voice pipeline. Currently a scoped proof-of-concept: one-time login/session-persistence against a single real site (Scholarship America), before scaling to the full scholarship list and the missing-info/essay-drafting/notification loop described in North_Vector's scholarship-automation fix note.
